newsitem.title: USA: Oak Technology sets stock rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Oak Technology sets stock rights plan.

text.p: Oak Technology Inc took a preemptive step against potential hostile takeover attempts Tuesday, saying it has set in motion a shareholder rights plan with a 15 percent trigger.

The speciality computer chip maker said in a statement that the plan is designed to force any person or interested party to negotiate with the board of directors about buying a controlling interest in the company.
Under the plan outlined by Oak, shareholders of record Aug 29 will receive preffered stock purchase rights as a dividend at the rate of one right for each share of common stock.

Oak said that if a person of group controlled 15 percent of its common stock, each right holder would be entitled to buy a fractional share of junior participating preferred stock upon certain circumstances.
The rights expire on Aug 29, 2007, but can be redeemed at any time by the board prior to that date, at a value of one cent each.
Oak said it will mail shareholders details of the rights plan.
